result_summary: Audited Facultad Digital / Study Library without promoting any route or mutating product bytes. Preserved the independent truth result that project-facultad is still discovery-required/unbound, while identifying pages/study-library V18.6 as the newest branch-published Study Library lineage. Mapped the main one-message correction frictions: unresolved route authority, no page-level correction bridge, incomplete return-context persistence, and V18 visibility still gated by the old remote-config + 13-script sequential loader.
material_advances: Separated Facultad project authority from the recent pages/study-library artifact and older catalogued shared/study family, preventing recency from becoming false authority.

Recovered exact V18 interaction invariants to preserve: four-year shelves, V18.6 label alignment, vertical viewport preservation across year switches, shelf-left reset, drag/click suppression, keyboard course opening, theme persistence and course deep links.
Identified that course_id is durable in URL/history but selected year, tab and semantic anchor are not, so same-surface correction return is currently incomplete.

Identified the non-obvious boot coupling: study-v10-loader owns the blocking overlay, waits on remote Supabase config, then sequentially awaits 13 legacy/core scripts even though V18 has an independent local-data render path.

Defined nine falsifiable UX tests for exact-context return, deterministic Facultad routing, V18-ready/legacy-lazy boot, mobile visual regression, drag safety, keyboard access and legacy fallback preservation.
Deduplicated all fix classes to existing surface-registry, Page Change Thread, steward, Facultad reuse/risk/discover/plan/local-integration lanes; emitted no redundant opportunity.
non_obvious_findings: The newest Study Library implementation is byte-identical on main and gh-pages yet absent from CURRENT_GRAPH/CATALOG_MANIFEST; publication/recency and canonical Facultad authority are materially different facts.
V18 modern UI readiness is visually subordinate to a legacy boot path that serializes remote config plus 13 scripts.
A course correction can reopen the correct course while still losing the user's exact task location because tab/year/anchor are not part of navigation state.
preserved_invariants: project-facultad remains REGISTERED_DISCOVERY_REQUIRED until an authorized binding exists.
Branch parity for pages/study-library is not upgraded to Served or canonical Current authority.
Older shared/study lineage remains available and is not overwritten by recency inference.
Recent V18.5/V18.6 scroll/shelf/visual behaviors are explicit regression constraints.
One-message correction should reuse shared Page Change Thread/surface-registry/steward substrate rather than fork a Facultad-only control plane.
/wc remains a canary; production /w is not promoted.

next_safe_frontier.instruction: Planner/integration should consume the UX artifact only after authority/reuse/risk evidence is available. First preserve explicit project/surface identity; then add context-capsule return semantics and decouple V18 visible readiness from legacy tool readiness with regression tests.
